name: com.sbadealcheck/sba-deal-check
title: SBA Deal Check (SOP 50 10 8.1)
description: SBA 7(a) acquisition stress tests, LOI checklists, and lender benchmarks from public data.

tools.name: stress_test_sba_deal
tools.description: Run a deterministic SBA 7(a) SOP 50 10 8.1 acquisition stress test. Computes buyer-salary-adjusted DSCR, maximum supportable loan and price, blended maturity (rounded before equity), FY 2027 upfront guaranty fee and waivers, 90-day multi-loan guaranty caps, $3M QoE trigger excluding owner-occupied real estate, and Nov 11, 2026 veteran 100% limited-equity flexibility with primary SOP citations. Call generate_loi_sba_checklist separately for sample LOI clauses.

tools.name: find_sba_acquisition_lenders
tools.description: Query public SBA 7(a) FOIA Change-of-Ownership loan aggregates by NAICS code, US state, and loan size. Separates trailing 24-month active acquisition approvals from seasoned FY2018-FY2021 charge-off cohorts, reporting sample size n and suppressing charge-off counts, dollars, and percentages when n < 10. Contains zero borrower PII.

state.title: State

loan_amount.description: Estimated SBA 7(a) loan amount in USD (up to $5,000,000).
loan_amount.title: Loan Amount

limit.description: Maximum number of lenders to return (1 to 25, default 10).
limit.title: Limit
